stem: A humidity sensor is mounted directly in the path of a humidifier discharge and is used to represent the entire room. What is the main concern?
choices: The sensor location may measure a local plume rather than representative canopy conditions
Humidity sensors must always be mounted inside humidifier discharge
Only air temperature matters for environmental control
rationale: Sensors should represent the conditions relevant to the crop. Direct exposure to a localized source can bias readings and should be evaluated before those data drive room-wide decisions.
